name: Transition-point / opposite guidance
plain: Tracks guidance norm across steps; before its first local minimum it uses unguided or opposite guidance, then normal CFG.
math:
Before transition: x̂ = u − λΔ (w_pre=−opposite)
Transition: step after local min of ‖Δ‖²; after: x̂=u+wΔ
